parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The **ClientToken** value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.description: This parameter is deprecated. Use `Permissions.N.Policy` to specify whether to allow inbound access.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the security group. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: SecurityGroupId

parameters.name: SecurityGroupRuleId
parameters.description: The security group rule IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 security group rule IDs in a request.

parameters.name: SourceGroupId
